name: px4-full-versus-partial-control-updates-v1
hypothesis: Jev can maintain a persistent velocity state and choose only changed channels without degrading mission success or safety.
primary_outcome: Paired strict pass: mission success, no contacts, no clearance/axis-rule violations, independent command audit passes.
controls: Same cameras, action facts, planner, rooms, reachable single-axis velocities, speed, 0.6 s lease and request cadence. Both arms receive current control state and resulting vectors. Patch offers minimal absolute assignments and keep_controls. No veto or automatic steering.
scope: Exploratory four paired scenes, not a reliability estimate. Pair seed controls layout, not stochastic model/network/physics execution. Combined-axis plumbing has a separate scripted native check. No yaw-rate or raw motor control.
